author: jordan
text: :red_circle: SEC-112 (critical): `GET /v1/exports/{id}` doesn't check that the export belongs to the caller's workspace. With a guessed id you can download another workspace's CSV. Staging only so far, Atlas isn't on in prod. This blocks ANY Atlas exposure, beta included, until fixed.

author: alex
text: Ugh, that's mine. The ownership check is in the list endpoint but not the fetch. Fixing today.

author: priya
text: Thanks Jordan. Treat Atlas as fully blocked until SEC-112 is fixed and retested.

author: marcus
text: Agree. Alex, please add a test that tries cross-workspace access on every endpoint, not just exports.

author: alex
text: PR #216 merged: ownership check on export fetch + a cross-tenant test for all 14 endpoints. All passing.

author: ingrid
text: ATLAS-44: Azure AD SAML assertions fail ~8% of logins with `NotBefore` errors. Azure's clock runs a few seconds ahead of ours and we allow zero skew. Okta tenant is fine. Fix is a 90-second skew tolerance (PR #223, open). Needs Jordan's review since it's auth.

author: jordan
text: 90s is standard. I'll review today. This doesn't affect beta (beta is email + password + MFA), only SSO verification on Nov 10.

author: jordan
text: Retested SEC-112 on staging: fixed. Cross-tenant tests pass. Remaining ATLAS-38 items are GA-only: enterprise SSO verification (ATLAS-41) and export audit log (ATLAS-50). Security does NOT block a flag-gated design-partner beta anymore.
